newsitem.title: JAPAN: HORSE RACING-ARC WINNER HELISSIO INVITED TO JAPAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-ARC WINNER HELISSIO INVITED TO JAPAN CUP.

text.p: Helissio, winner of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, heads a group of 10 foreign horses invited to run in next month's Japan Cup, the Japan Racing Association said on Monday.
The French-bred three-year-old colt has won six of his seven races this year, including a magnificent victory in the Arc earlier this month.

The 2,400-metre race on November 24, worth 132 million yen ($1.3 million) to the winner, will also feature British four-year-old Pilsudski, who won the Breeders' Cup Turf in Toronto on Saturday and was runner-up to Helissio in the Arc.
Those invited from North America include 1995 Arlington Million champion Awad and 1996 Pacific Classic Stakes winner Dare and Go.
Six horses have been invited from Japan, four from Europe, four from North America and two from Oceania.
